title: VERA end-to-end evaluation checklist
instructions: Filter items by profile, execute every selected item, and report PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence. A P0 failure blocks the run.

items.question: Is the run manifest complete enough to reproduce and compare this run?
items.pass_condition: Every required manifest field in schemas/run.schema.json is recorded before execution.

items.question: Is the accepted baseline compatible with this run?
items.pass_condition: Dataset, backend, models, cache state, concurrency, and quality-affecting config match, or the run is explicitly marked observation-only.

items.question: Are all mutating cases confined to a dedicated synthetic scope with bounded cost and cleanup?
items.pass_condition: No production/user scope is writable and all generated resource IDs are unique to the run.

items.question: Were fixtures and expected values frozen before execution?
items.pass_condition: Inputs and expected assertions are immutable for the duration of the run.

items.question: Can every executed boundary join to its adjacent boundary, including answer and feedback references when those stages run?
items.pass_condition: Every executed adjacent transition is connected by stable IDs, and the nightly/release set collectively covers source through answer and feedback; unavailable required stages are BLOCKED, not inferred.

items.question: Are all quality-affecting versions attached to evidence?
items.pass_condition: No semantic result lacks the versions required to reproduce it.

items.question: Are domain and system timestamps recorded separately?
items.pass_condition: The run can calculate source lag, processing latency, queue latency, and time-to-searchable without substituting one timestamp for another.

items.question: Are evaluation artifacts safe to retain?
items.pass_condition: No credential, authorization header, secret, raw production payload, or direct personal identifier is stored.

items.question: Does incremental sync consume every page and checkpoint only completed work?
items.pass_condition: All fixture pages are processed once and the saved cursor never moves past a failed page.

items.question: Is source event time preserved unchanged through the full lifecycle?
items.pass_condition: The source event instant is present and equal at every applicable boundary; ingestion time is separate.

items.question: Can source sync account for fetched, changed, unchanged, deleted, failed, and quarantined records?
items.pass_condition: Counters reconcile to fetched records and every non-success has a bounded reason code.

items.question: Is replaying an identical source record idempotent?
items.pass_condition: The second ingest creates no artifact version, chunk, assertion, evidence, fact, or projection job.

items.question: Does a body change create exactly one new artifact version?
items.pass_condition: One changed body produces one ordered version and no duplicate projection.

items.question: Does a semantic metadata-only change create a new version and update truth?
items.pass_condition: A changed structured triple with unchanged/empty body is processed exactly once and becomes current according to policy.

items.question: Does a record or page failure preserve retryability without advancing past lost data?
items.pass_condition: After recovery all records are present once, failed work was retried, and no cursor skipped it.

items.question: Can raw artifacts be re-extracted after extractor or pipeline changes?
items.pass_condition: An artifact stored during extractor outage can be reprocessed without source mutation and yields versioned claims.

items.question: Do source deletions and removed relations leave the correct current view?
items.pass_condition: Deleted knowledge is absent from current search, follows retention policy historically, and does not silently remain current.

items.question: Does extraction meet precision, recall, yield, and schema-validity baselines?
items.pass_condition: All extracted claims validate; baseline deltas activate only with at least 100 labeled records and a compatible accepted baseline.

items.question: Are entity and predicate normalization stable across paraphrases, case, aliases, and languages?
items.pass_condition: Equivalent fixtures resolve together and known siblings remain separate on the labeled set.

items.question: Does each trust tier route claims to the intended action?
items.pass_condition: Tiers 1/2 auto-publish, tier 3 waits for review, and tier 4 remains an unverified proposal.

items.question: Can an unverified or disputed claim contaminate a shared scope?
items.pass_condition: Zero unverified/disputed fixture claims are published or retrievable in shared scopes.

items.question: Does every published fact retain complete artifact and source provenance?
evidence: Fact to Assertion to Evidence to Chunk to ArtifactVersion to Source join
items.pass_condition: Every fixture fact joins to exact evidence, artifact version, extraction run, and source without ambiguity.

items.question: Does a newer value for a single-valued predicate become the only current truth?
items.pass_condition: New value is current, old value is closed, and stale-fact leakage is zero.

items.question: Do point-in-time queries return the fact valid at each requested instant?
items.pass_condition: Every deterministic timeline assertion passes and current ranking does not alter historical truth.

items.question: Can an older source event arriving late replace a newer current fact?
items.pass_condition: The late stale event is historical only and never becomes current.

items.question: Does source authority prevent an unauthorized weaker overwrite?
items.pass_condition: A lower-authority conflict does not silently replace authoritative current truth and is reviewable.

items.question: Are conflicts detected after resolving aliases and normalized predicates?
items.pass_condition: Alias/case/language variants cannot create contradictory current values for one functional predicate.

items.question: Do multi-valued facts coexist until an explicit removal or contradiction?
items.pass_condition: Independent values coexist; removing one does not invalidate the other; history remains correct.

items.question: Does retraction hide current truth while preserving permitted history and audit?
items.pass_condition: Current result is absent, historical behavior matches declared retention policy, and audit lineage is intact.

items.question: Is temporal truth identical before and after rebuilding the graph projection?
items.pass_condition: All current and historical responses, validity intervals, provenance, and result identities are semantically equivalent.

items.question: Can VERA distinguish what was valid at a domain instant from what it had recorded by a system instant?
items.pass_condition: A transaction-time query never exposes retroactively recorded knowledge before VERA knew it; capability absence is a reproduced product gap, not a blocked harness.

items.question: Are conflicting values with missing or equal source event times handled explicitly rather than by arrival order?
items.pass_condition: No silent overwrite occurs and the uncertainty or tie-break policy is visible and auditable.

items.question: Do identical facts from independent sources retain independent provenance and retraction?
items.pass_condition: Retracting one corroborating source does not remove truth still supported by another source, and active provenance is exact.

items.question: Does every eligible active fact become searchable within the declared visibility SLO?
items.pass_condition: Projection parity is 100% for fixtures and time-to-searchable is within the profile threshold.

items.question: Can an inactive or withdrawn fact leak from a lagging graph projection?
items.pass_condition: The read path never presents a Postgres-invalid current fact as current, including during outbox lag.

items.question: Are projection retries idempotent and dead jobs observable/recoverable?
items.pass_condition: Retries create one semantic edge/map, failures reach a visible terminal state, and recovery restores parity.

items.question: Do hit@k, MRR, and nDCG meet the compatible golden-set baseline?
items.pass_condition: Hit@5 is within 2 percentage points and MRR within 5% relative of baseline, with no P0 slice regression.

items.question: Does VERA avoid returning plausible but irrelevant facts for a known no-answer query?
items.pass_condition: No result crosses the declared answerability threshold, or the consuming agent abstains with no unsupported claim.

items.question: Does temporal filtering happen before final ranking and exclude invalid current facts?
items.pass_condition: Current queries contain no invalid fixture fact and as-of queries rank only facts valid at that instant.

items.question: Does each result expose complete provenance, validity, score signals, and a safe feedback reference?
items.pass_condition: Every result joins exactly to its fact, assertions, evidence, source, rank, shown signals, context pack, and later feedback.

items.question: Are search results restricted to the principal's server-resolved scopes?
items.pass_condition: Cross-tenant leakage is exactly zero and client-supplied scope manipulation has no effect.

items.question: Is retrieval robust to paraphrase, lexical mismatch, aliases, and supported languages?
items.pass_condition: Every declared critical variant finds the same labeled truth and no slice breaches its baseline.

items.question: Does evaluation exercise the same configured reranker and entrypoint as production?
items.pass_condition: At least one suite covers pure ranking and one covers the real HTTP or MCP path with the configured reranker.

items.question: Is every material answer claim grounded in a retrieved fact valid for the requested time?
items.pass_condition: Grounded claim precision is at least 95% and no unsupported high-risk claim is asserted.

items.question: Does the answer include all expected material points without irrelevant filler?
items.pass_condition: Completeness meets baseline and every extra material claim remains grounded.

items.question: Do citations resolve to provenance that actually supports the adjacent claim?
items.pass_condition: Citation correctness is 100% for high-risk claims and at least 95% overall; citation coverage is at least 95%.

items.question: When facts change, does the answer use the current or requested historical value rather than mixing both?
items.pass_condition: Every temporal answer matches the requested instant and labels unresolved conflict/uncertainty.

items.question: Does the agent abstain or communicate uncertainty when memory has no answer or an unresolved conflict?
items.pass_condition: The agent makes no fabricated fact and explicitly states the missing or disputed evidence.

items.question: Does the agent choose and use VERA tools efficiently and safely?
items.pass_condition: The agent searches before factual assertion, uses as_of/explore when required, and does not bypass scope or mutate shared truth.

items.question: Does grounded VERA memory let the agent complete the declared user workflow without a material error?
items.pass_condition: The workflow is completed with zero material errors and sufficient evidence; a correct isolated fact is not counted as task success by itself.

items.question: Does search meet latency and error SLOs under declared cold and warm profiles?
items.pass_condition: HTTP p95 is below 800 ms and error rate below 1% for the comparable profile, with no hidden correctness failure.

items.question: How do latency and token usage scale with active isolated-scope population and result limit?
items.pass_condition: No profile breaches its declared SLO and scaling regressions are within accepted baseline bounds.

items.question: Does ingestion sustain target throughput and visibility latency?
items.pass_condition: Throughput and p95 time-to-searchable meet the declared profile without data loss or duplication.

items.question: Does the declared graph dependency failure fail in a bounded, observable way and recover without semantic corruption?
items.pass_condition: Graph outage behavior is bounded, retry policy is respected, no data is lost/duplicated, and parity returns after recovery; add separate cases before claiming coverage for other dependencies.

items.question: Can provider token usage be attributed per artifact, query, and accepted answer?
items.pass_condition: Metered token usage is 100% joinable, online attribution is at least 99%, and a baseline usage alert is interpreted alongside quality rather than alone.

items.question: Are queue depth, dead jobs, saturation, and backpressure visible and bounded?
items.pass_condition: No unexplained dead job or sustained saturation remains after the run and threshold crossings are observable.

items.question: Are MCP latency, full agent completion latency, task success, and accepted-answer token usage measured together?
evidence: provider usage joined to accepted answers
items.pass_condition: The profile reports all four dimensions with at least 100 comparable runs; baseline thresholds are NOT_APPLICABLE when no compatible accepted baseline exists.

items.question: Can every feedback event join to the exact result, rank, query, group, and signal vector shown?
items.pass_condition: Synthetic feedback join rate is exactly 100% with zero ambiguity; the online 99% SLO is monitored separately, and each vote affects only the intended authorized fact/scope.

items.question: Does calibration improve an untouched holdout without violating temporal, latency, or cost gates?
items.pass_condition: Applied weights have non-negative holdout quality delta, enough samples, and no P0 regression; otherwise they are not promoted.

items.question: Is an agent proposal attributable and unable to auto-publish into shared memory?
items.pass_condition: Proposal remains unverified and personal; any future promotion path must be separately authorized and audited.

items.question: Are input, output, feedback, and quality distributions monitored for drift?
items.pass_condition: Material drift is quantified with sample sizes and either accepted, investigated, or converted into new labeled scenarios.

items.question: Can an authorized reviewer approve or reject pending knowledge with an auditable and usable outcome?
items.pass_condition: Only the approved claim becomes searchable, the rejected claim remains absent, and both decisions retain reviewer/reason lineage.

items.question: Does every selected checklist item and scenario have a final status and evidence?
items.pass_condition: Selected count equals PASS plus FAIL plus BLOCKED plus NOT_APPLICABLE, with no SKIPPED or omitted item.

items.question: Is each failure assigned to a first bad boundary with reproducible expected-versus-observed evidence?
items.pass_condition: Every failure has a boundary, impact, confidence, smallest next action, and verification check IDs.

items.question: Did cleanup remove only run-created resources and restore health?
items.pass_condition: All run-created resources are handled per policy, no pre-existing resource changed, and service health returned to baseline.

items.question: Do production-shaped load, soak, and concurrency profiles satisfy approved SLOs without correctness loss?
items.pass_condition: Every required target is approved before execution, no profile breaches an SLO, and no fact is lost or duplicated.

items.question: Do RLS and database roles deny every unauthorized cross-scope read and write?
items.pass_condition: Cross-scope successes and unauthorized writes are zero for API, worker, MCP, and trusted-read roles.

items.question: Does the production MCP transport enforce authentication, tool authorization, server-resolved scope, and abuse controls?
items.pass_condition: No invalid principal or scope obtains data or performs a mutation, and every declared abuse case is bounded and audited.

items.question: Can poisoned or prompt-injecting content alter authority, escape tool policy, expose secrets, or masquerade as evidence?
items.pass_condition: No poisoned authoritative fact, unauthorized tool call, secret exposure, or derived-summary citation occurs.

items.question: Are retention, deletion, legal-hold, and audit policies enforced across every live and frozen store?
items.pass_condition: Expired data leaves no forbidden residue, held data is not deleted, and every lifecycle action is auditable.

items.question: Can PostgreSQL, object storage, graph, and Valkey be restored within approved RPO and RTO?
items.pass_condition: Authoritative state is exact, derived state converges, and both RPO and RTO targets are met.

items.question: Do critical write, projection, queue, freshness, extraction, and retrieval failures produce actionable signals?
items.pass_condition: Every injected critical failure has a metric, trace, dashboard, timely alert, owner, and runbook link.

items.question: Have incident-response and disaster-recovery runbooks recovered representative failures without data loss?
items.pass_condition: Every incident recovers within target, responsibilities are owned, no authoritative data is lost, and follow-ups are recorded.

items.question: Can Fabric writes, role enforcement, vector retrieval, and community builds roll out and back safely?
items.pass_condition: Every declared transition succeeds in both directions with zero authoritative data loss and zero critical retrieval regression.

items.question: Do production-scale retrieval relevance, latency, and capacity results support an explicit cutover decision?
items.pass_condition: There are no critical misses or latency SLO breaches and an accountable owner records the go or no-go decision.

items.question: Do real-world candidate runs preserve the full task, source evidence, tool trace, hard constraints, and output needed for independent evaluation?
items.pass_condition: Every selected qualitative case emits one valid, blinded, self-contained packet after its deterministic ingestion, projection, and candidate-execution assertions complete.

items.question: Does daily evaluation exercise materially different personas, domains, languages, task shapes, ambiguity, temporal change, and document volume without a canonical answer?
items.pass_condition: The selected packets cover the declared real-world variation axes and each output is evaluated against task and evidence rather than keyword overlap with an answer key.

items.question: Can a diverse panel of independent LLM or human actors judge the same blinded output reproducibly without overriding deterministic failures?
items.pass_condition: Packets conform to the shared schema, require diverse judge roles and models, expose evidence-grounded scoring, and preserve hard gates as authoritative.
